caption: Lost your job? Epictetus was born a slave, won his freedom, then lost his city to an emperor's decree. His first lesson: separate what's in your power from what isn't. Full breakdown on our page. #stoicism #epictetus #layoffs #resilience #mindset

Where does your $5 latte go? Starbucks's own fiscal 2025 numbers: $2.29 runs the store, $1.57 buys the coffee, milk and cup, and about 25 cents is profit. Data: Starbucks FY2025 results (SEC filing); company-wide shares applied to a $5 example. #starbucks #coffee #latte #personalfinance #dollartrail

Sunday night, and Monday is already in your head. Seneca's fix: walk through the week's problems on paper before they show up, and end with a plan instead of a loop. Save this for next Sunday. Source: Seneca, Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter 91, tr. Richard M. Gummere. #stoicism #seneca #sundayscaries #mindset #stoic

A $12.09 AMC ticket, followed: $5.81 of it went to the studios. The theater makes its money at the snack bar, and in 2025 it barely broke even. Data: AMC Entertainment full-year 2025 results (SEC Form 8-K, Feb. 2026); per-visit figures = 2025 totals divided by 219.4 million admissions. #movies #amc #popcorn #personalfinance #dollartrail
